headline: Los Angeles County Rents Fall to a Four-Year Low, but Housing Still Stretches New Graduates' Budgets
summary: This year's college graduates heading to Los Angeles County are entering a rental market that's more affordable than it has been in years, but housing costs remain high for many just starting their careers. The median asking rent fell to $2,603 in the second quarter of 2026, down $91, or 3.4%, from a year earlier and the lowest level since the end of 2021, according to the Q2 2026 Los Angeles County Rental Report from Realtor.com®.
